svg.desc: LoRA: the input x goes through the frozen weight W (d by k) and, in parallel, through a trainable r by k matrix A and a d by r matrix B that starts at zero; the adapter output is scaled by alpha over r and added. Trainable parameters per layer are r times (d plus k): 12,288 instead of 589,824 for a 768 by 768 layer at rank 8.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: LoRA: a frozen weight plus a trainable low-rank update

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: h = W x + (α / r) · B A x, with r ≪ d.

svg.text: Merge after training: W′ = W + (α/r)·B·A has W's shape, so serving costs nothing extra.

svg.text: B = 0 at init, so training starts exactly at the pretrained model.
